name: viscose-carousel
title: Viscose Carousel
description: A ring of project cards drawn as one WebGL shader: the cards melt into each other and string threads of honey as the ring turns, with a cursor drop, momentum and snapping.
author: Yousuf Soomro <https://github.com/Yousuf-developer>
docs:
Installed `ViscoseCarousel` (with its engine, Motion tweens and shaders) in `components/ui/`, plus the `render-loop` helper in `lib/`. Render `<ViscoseCarousel items={items} onOpen={(item) => ...} className="h-dvh w-full" />`; it fills its box, so size it with `className`.

Each item is `{ title, image, discipline?, year? }`; images are drawn into a WebGL texture, so they must be same-origin or served with CORS. Up to 18 cards. Tune anything with `params` (for example `params={{ goo: 50 }}`). Rendering pauses off screen and in hidden tabs; under reduced motion or without WebGL 2 a static picture shows instead.

Needs `three` and `motion` (installed) and, for TypeScript, `@types/three`. Ported from Yousuf-developer/Viscose-carousel (MIT, copyright 2026 Yousuf Soomro); the license text is in each file.
